batting.name: Mandeep Singh
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b DJ Bravo

batting.name: DA Miller
batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b JA Morkel

batting.name: DJ Hussey
batting.dismissal: c SB Jakati b JA Morkel

batting.name: PP Chawla
batting.dismissal: c DJ Bravo b JA Morkel

batting.name: S Badrinath
batting.dismissal: c P Dogra b Azhar Mahmood

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: st N Saini b PP Chawla

batting.name: RA Jadeja
batting.dismissal: c DJ Hussey b PP Chawla

batting.name: DJ Bravo
batting.dismissal: c PP Chawla b P Kumar

batting.name: JA Morkel
batting.dismissal: c SE Marsh b Azhar Mahmood

balls.text: Bravo sprints at full pelt towards his left from long-off and stretches out his right hand to swat the ball, preventing Kumar's flat hit from going over the extra cover boundary

caught and bowled! It was a slower delivery - 106 kph - on a good length and straight line. Saini slogged, aiming for deep midwicket, he ended up slicing the ball high in the air towards short midwicket. Kulasekara called for the catch and took it
Saini's moved across his stumps and chipped a length ball over short fine leg, not very well timed so Morkel chases it down
another full toss outside off stump, Kumar hits it towards the fielder on the sweeper boundary
in the blockhole, Kumar digs it out towards the off side, Kulasekara moves quickly to his left and dives full length to save runs
the first ball is a loose full toss outside off stump, Kumar slaps it off the back foot over cover, doesn't find the boundary though
another slower ball on off and middle stump, Kumar dabs it on the off side and runs
another slower ball, Praveen Kumar defends on the front foot

Sharma's been run out! Saini backed away towards leg, Bravo followed him with a full and slower ball, Saini was beaten but the batsmen decided to try and steal a bye to Dhoni, who hit the stumps direct with his under-arm throw
short ball and Saini has pulled it for four, I forgot that he was still in the dug out when Hussey got out. He hit that with power from outside off
Bravo goes round the wicket and finds the blockhole, the batsman digs it out on the leg side
short ball down leg side, rubbish line and length for a slower ball. Sharma pulls it over short fine leg
pulled towards deep square leg, not very well timed
bottom-edged close to the stumps, Sharma was trying to cut

tremendous catch! Bravo sprinted forward and to his right from long-off to get under a mis-hit from Chawla, he then had to leap in the air as the ball descended, arching his body and catching the ball in mid air, holding it safely as his body slammed into the ground

a comedy of errors! Chawla pushed a slower ball limply towards cover and did not run. Sharma ran a long way down from the non-striker's end before having to turn around. Jakati misfielded at midwicket, he had time to recover and throw the ball to Morkel but he made a mess of that as well

pulled hard but straight to Jakati at midwicket! That is an important strike for Chennai, the last of the specialist batsmen has been dismissed with plenty of overs remaining. The ball from Morkel was short and Hussey pulled with power off the front foot, he just did not place it well
the slower offcutter, played in front of point

a low full toss and Hussey biffs it hard past the bowler, Faf sprints to his left from long on and dives full length, he gets a hand on the ball but can't prevent four. Bravo collided with Hussey during his follow through

Mandeep cleared his front foot and tried to smash the ball over the straight boundary, he mis-timed it and the ball began its descent about mid-way to the long-off boundary, Raina came running in from the deep and caught it
Mandeep makes room but Bravo follows him with a full ball, the batsman flicks through square leg
full delivery swinging into the right-hander, Hussey drives through cover
in the blockhole and Mandeep manages to dig it out on the leg side

huge appeal for lbw after Mandeep moves across his crease towards the off side and tries to scoop over short fine leg, he misses and gets hit on the pad, the impact was outside off stump. The ball was very full from Bravo
cut off the back foot towards deep point

caught behind! That's a strange one. Morkel bowled a slower short ball, Miller got into position to pull initially and then had to wait for the ball to reach him, he then decided to chip it over the keeper instead. All he managed was to edge it straight to Dhoni
Miller mis-times the pull again, this time to a quicker ball, the ball hits the body and goes on the off side. Mandeep wants the single and bumps into Morkel, who runs to his right to field the ball
the slower ball just outside off stump, Miller tries to pull but is beaten
Miller comes forward and chips the full ball in the air, over the infield and wide of Bravo at long-on
short of a length, a slower ball, Miller pulls along the ground to square leg

there's been a head on collision at full tilt on the straight boundary between Faf and Bravo. Both players are down on the ground and the physio is attending to them. Mandeep chipped the ball in the air right over the bowler's head. Both Faf and Bravo, from long on and long off, converged on the ball and smashed into each other.
Miller steps out but Ashwin angles the ball into him and slows the pace down, Miller adjusts and pushes on the off side
Miller steps out and works the ball through square leg, Miller urges Mandeep back for the second, Mandeep is visibly tiring in this heat
Mandeep makes room and chips the ball toward long-on, well short of the fielder
Miller stays in his crease and forces the ball through midwicket
nudged off the pads behind square, and that single gives Mandeep his maiden IPL fifty. He's done a good job of anchoring this innings
full and wide outside off stump again, Mandeep reaches for the ball and hits it to deep cover
a low full toss, driven on the front foot to long-off
Miller lays into a length ball and lofts it flat over extra cover, Jadeja runs to his right from long-off and dives but can't prevent the boundary
Mandeep tried to drive the full and wide ball but edged it to third man, where Morkel fields
in the blockhole outside off stump, Mandeep tries to steer to third man but is beaten
good length on middle stump, played from the crease towards square leg
Mandeep moves towards the leg side to make room and then lofts a length ball over extra cover, didn't hit it hard, just looked to place it in the gap
nudged off the back foot towards midwicket
the slower ball just outside off, Miller pulls too early and gets beaten
fuller and straighter, Miller clips the ball through midwicket and runs hard for the second
good length from Morkel outside off stump, slanting the ball across the left-hander, Miller tries to cut but gets a bottom edge
that's an odd shot to play the ball after Mahmood got out, Mandeep mis-times the pull against a short delivery but the ball falls safely at deep square leg

lbw! Bravo pitched the ball on a good length just outside off and nipped it back into the right-hander, Mahmood tried to steer towards third man and opened the face to do so, he played down the wrong line though and was struck plumb in front
short ball outside off stump, Mandeep swats it towards wide long-on where Jadeja fields
the slower ball on middle and leg, Mahmood plays it towards square leg
Mandeep stays in his crease and aims to swing a full ball through midwicket, he gets an inside edge towards fine leg. This is now Mandeep's highest score in the IPL
Mandeep charges and swings, Bravo angles the ball into the right-hander and cramps him for room, the ball passes between the batsman and leg stump
short of a length and straight, Mandeep pulls in front of square leg
nudged off the pads towards short fine leg, Mahmood set off fro the single but was sent back. Jadeja went over the wicket to Mahmood after those sixes.
Mandeep backs away towards leg and pulls the ball towards deep midwicket
driven through cover for a single
well there's more power in this one for sure, the ball has disappeared over the long-on boundary again. Mahmood simply swung through the line of the ball
Mahmood gets under the length of a full ball and lofts it cleanly over long-on, didn't use much power in the strike, best to save energy in this humidity
Mandeep makes room and chips the ball towards long off
length ball outside off stump, Mahmood cuts but doesn't make contact
that's down leg side, too far away for Mahmood to connect with his flick
Mandeep tries to whip through square leg but mis-times towards midwicket instead
once again Mahmood steers the ball past Faf at backward point, it was a full delivery outside off stump this time
Mandeep pulls one that's not too short and mis-times it towards mid-on, there's no fielder in the circle
backs away and drives a length ball towards extra cover where Raina moves to his left and fields
short of a length outside off stump, Mahmood stays back and opens the face to steer behind point
nudged off the pads towards square leg
that's wide outside off and it beats the bat
punched off the back foot towards point
short and wide outside off, Mahmood cuts and the fielder at point mis-fields
played off the back foot through square leg ...

Has Marsh been run out while backing up at the bowler's end? He has! Mandeep drove the ball hard and straight, back at Ashwin. The bowler bent down but didn't even get a proper hand on it, instead the ball deflected off his boot and hit the stumps. Marsh was out of his crease and lunged back to try and regain his ground. He was just short. Some might say that's unlucky, but if you back up too far, you're taking the risk. Ok, Ashwin might have got fingertips on it, but the deflection that caused it to hit the stumps was off the boot
Mandeep steps out and then drives inside out through cover
stays in his crease and works the ball off his pads through square leg
quick ball wide outside off stump, Marsh cuts and beats two fielders behind point and finds the third man boundary
along the ground this time, Marsh steps out and drills the ball past the bowler, Jakati did not have time to stick his boot out, or maybe he decided not to
that's a golf swing, and an immense one. Marsh stepped out of his crease, got to the pitch of the ball, and swung his arms with a flourish, hitting the ball over the sight screen
lapped around the corner for a single, not very pretty
played on the leg side for a single

Mandeep bottom edges the cut into the ground and near his stumps, the ball bounces up and down for a while, and once it's clear that it's not going to hit the stumps Mandeep reaches down and touches it with his glove. That's asking for trouble, leave the ball alone, son!
drifting into the left-hander from round the wicket, Marsh clips it with the angle through midwicket to bring up the 50-stand
nudged off the pads towards square
a full toss, which Marsh hits through midwicket
Marsh goes back to cut Raina, who replaced Ashwin and is bowling from round the wicket, but gets an outside edge to the third man boundary
swept to the fielder at short fine leg
bowled full and straight, Mandeep dabs on the off side and wants one, Marsh does not
Mandeep goes inside out and lofts the ball over cover, he's timed that very well and placed it into the gap, Jakati's length allowed Mandeep to get under the ball and make room
played down the ground towards long on
Marsh comes forward and smashes the ball back at Jakati, he stretches his right boot out and blocks it, that would have hurt had it hit the ankle
defended on the front foot towards the off side
good length and straight, Mandeep gets behind the line and blocks
played back to the bowler
he's launched that over wide long-on, Mandeep made room and got under the length of the ball, hitting it cleanly and just far enough
Mandeep moves forward and nudges on the leg side, Ashwin is taking all the pace off the ball
played off the back foot through midwicket
Mandeep gets down low and sweeps past the catcher at leg slip
played back to the bowler once again
Marsh was looking to hit the good length ball on the leg side but checked his shot and defended back to the bowler
nearly in the blockhole outside off stump, Mandeep plays it to mid-off, who is on the edge of the circle, and runs
short of a length outside off, skiddy ball, Mandeep charges and slashes outside off, but he makes no contact
width outside off again, a bit fuller, Mandeep drives this time but can't beat cover
width outside off stump, Mandeep has slapped the ball powerfully through cover, he hit that on the up
bowled slowly through the air, Marsh defends after pushing forward
played off the pads behind square
slightly short around off stump, cut from the crease to point
drifts down leg side this time from round the wicket
played towards midwicket for a single
defended on the front foot, the ball takes the inside edge on the leg side
Marsh closes his face too early while playing towards leg side, he gets a leading edge that goes past first slip ...turn right away for Ashwin
full length on off and middle, Mandeep drives off the front foot to mid-on
full and straight, Mandeep clips the ball off his pads towards deep midwicket
that's too short, and on this pitch it sat up for Mandeep Singh, who dispatched the ball to the midwicket boundary with a crisp swivel pull, he hit that from outside off stump
short ball, Marsh swivels and pulls to the fielder at deep backward square leg
defended on the back foot towards the off side
this outfield is very quick, Marsh simply opened his face and gently steered the ball, which then raced through backward point and gave third man no chance at all
too straight this time, Marsh clips the ball off his pads behind square
good length and straight, Marsh moves forward and blocks
a third wide, this time down leg side to the left-hander. Kulasekara is not helping himself by bowling nine-ball overs in this heat.
cut hard off the back foot towards point, Faf dives to his left but can't stop it cleanly
Saha moves quickly to his right at mid-off to cut off a firm biff down the ground
he did not time the pull that well but the ball raced across the outfield and beat both mid-on and midwicket in pursuit, the length wasn't too short from Kulasekara
fuller and closer to the right-hander, driven on the front foot to cover
that's wider than the previous one, Kulasekara is getting the ball to move away from the right-hander, but he's starting too wide. Mandeep chases again
too wide outside off stump, Mandeep chases without moving his feet, trying to cut, but can't reach the ball
driven to wide long on for two runs, Punjab win by seven runs. Quite an upset this, especially after the start Chennai got to their chase

Kulasekara moved right out side his off stump to play behind square, Mahmood bowled a full ball just outside leg stump, the batsman missed and then ran as the ball went to the keeper. It's not been given wide and rightly so. He had moved so far outside off stump. Ashwin does not like it, and he exchanges words with Praveen Kumar. Chennai have lost this.
in the blockhole, not much Ashwin can do with that, he forces it through midwicket
Ashwin reverse scoops the ball from off and middle stump over short third man for four! Superb improvisation. Super Kings need four more per ball. That was premeditated but well executed
in the blockhole, Kulasekara drives it down the ground to long on, just the single

Morkel's holed out! Surely Kings XI have this game now. It was a full ball slanting wide outside off stump, Morkel swung hard, aiming for wide long-on, his favourite region. He ended up slicing the ball high in the air, so high that Marsh had time to run in from long-off and take the catch just outside the circle at mid-off

that's a lucky boundary for Chennai, a full ball on middle and leg, Kulasekara swings hard, aiming for midwicket or square leg, he gets an edge that goes past the keeper to the fine leg boudnary, that went between Kulasekara's legs

caught at deep midwicket! And caught very well! Bravo came forward, made room and heaved across the line, pulling the slower ball towards the fielder. Chawla came in from the boundary and then lunged to his right to take a crucial catch for his team
a full ball on middle and leg, Bravo calls two two two as soon as he flicks it towards deep midwicket, gets two easily

length ball on off and middle, Bravo moves forward swings across the line, he mis-times it behind square but sprints back for the second. Sharma fielded that ball behind square but has hurt himself as he threw it to the keeper. A substitute will be needed
a full toss, the yorker gone wrong, Bravo can get under this one and he powers it over the straight boundary with a thumping shot
full and straight, Morkel can't get under it and he hits through midwicket, along the ground
he can! Another full ball outside off, Morkel biffs it hard and flat to the fielder at long-off
a low full toss which Bravo can only drive to long-on, Marsh got to the ball quickly
in the blockhole once again, terrific bowling, not allowing Morkel to get under the ball, driven to long off for a single
Bravo moved outside leg stump but Awana followed him with a blockhole delivery, Bravo had to dig it out to long on
full ball on middle stump, Bravo flicks the ball towards deep midwicket, didn't get under it so couldn't time it well
full ball outside off stump, Morkel plays it out towards point
Morkel bashes the ball down the ground to long off, 11 off the over. A run and a half less than what was needed at the start of the over.
Praveen got away with a full toss on the pads, Bravo clipped it to fine leg
length ball and Bravo gets under it and hammers it over the long on boundary, the fielder was in the circle at mid-on
superb yorker, Bravo had made room by moving towards the leg side and was beaten between bat and leg stump
a full ball down leg side, Bravo watches it go past
in the blockhole outside off stump, Morkel muscles the ball towards long off
full and straight, Bravo drives to long-off, where Marsh runs in quickly to keep the batsmen to one
a full toss which Bravo drives to long on
Bravo dabs the ball with soft hands towards midwicket, the fielder has to run in from the boundary and so the batsmen had time to complete two
Morkel digs out the yorker towards extra cover and runs
Bravo leans forward once again to flick the ball off his pads through square leg
Bravo moves forward and flicks through square leg
the slower ball on off stump, Morkel moves forward and drives on the off side
flat ball outside off, Bravo tries to cut but gets beaten
Bravo steps out but has to defend in the end because he hasn't got to the pitch of the ball
that's fired down leg side, a wide
Kings XI have got another one! Jadeja tried to launch the googly into orbit on the leg side but ended up top-edging it high in the air toward cover, Hussey settled under the ball and caught it
pulled through square leg
dropped at long-off! Marsh has dropped a sitter. Bravo chipped a full ball flat to Marsh, who had to run forward but got to the ball well in time, he seemed to have caught it but it popped out
Bravo tries to drive from his crease and is beaten outside off stump
huge hit down the ground, Jadeja charged, got under the flighted delivery and hammered it with a full swing of the bat, he did not hold back at all
a bail's fallen off, but I don't know how. And no one seems to have noticed. Maybe it was the keeper's glove that knocked it off. Jadeja played the ball off the back foot towards point
driven off the back foot through point
defended on the front foot

Dhoni doesn't know where the ball is and he's been run out! He bottom edged the ball into the ground near his feet and it bounced up behind him. Dhoni thought the ball might have gone away from the pitch and took a few steps out of his crease. By the time he realised the ball was close, it was too late, the keeper Saini moved quickly to his left, picked up the ball and broke the stumps
a huge mix up but the throw is to the wrong end! Dhoni dabbed the ball straight to Mahmood at short third man, Jadeja sprinted off for the single, but Mahmood threw to Dhoni's end.
nudged off the pads behind square
played back to the bowler from the crease
bowled him! Saha slogged across the line at a flat ball angled across him from round the wicket, he got an inside edge on to his leg and then on to his stumps
Jadeja slogs the ball flat towards long-on
played towards midwicket for a single
a full toss and Saha misses the heave behind square, he gets some bat on it and manages to play towards short fine leg, the fielder makes a half stop
Jadeja plays the ball off his pads towards wide long-on, the fielder has to run forward and to his left from the boundary and by the time he covers the distance they've begun to run the second
that's a short ball and only marginally down leg side, the batsman refrains from pulling and the umpire call's it wide
in the blockhole outside off stump, Jadeja tries to squeeze it behind point but is beaten
driven to cover for a single
Chawla's dropped a catch at midwicket. Another short ball and Jadeja pulled it flat towards Chawla's left, the fielder lunged, got both hands to it but could not hold on
short ball and Jadeja pulls with power past the bowler, mid-on is in the circle and there's no protection on the boundary
Saha tries to force the ball through the off side but gets a bottom edge past his stumps towards the keeper's left, they run a single before Saini can reach the ball
played of the pads behind square, that's two tight overs in a row for Kings XI.
pushed off the front foot towards point, Saha wanted one but Jadeja did not
worked of the back foot behind square leg
defended on the front foot towards the leg side

Raina's been stumped and he's hurt himself as well. He came forward, dragging his back foot out as he lunged to play the quicker ball that slid across him, Saini collected and whipped off the bails, Raina did a split of sorts as he tried to regain ground and then fell over
Raina backs away to try and hit on the off side, he gets an inside edge towards fine leg
Saha moves forward and across to play a length ball angling into him towards midwicket. Tight over from Awana, who's had a good tournament so far
Raina stays in his crease and lofts a length ball over point, falls short of the fielder in the deep
played off the front foot towards the off side, Miller moves quickly from cover and cuts it off
played from the crease towards cover
Saha steers a length ball towards third man and sprints the single
short ball at 137 kph, Raina pulls it down behind square leg
played with soft hands close on the off side, Saha wants one, Raina sends him back. The umpires signal the first time-out.
bowled on leg stump, Raina gets down low and sweeps to long leg
driven on the front foot through cover
played off the back foot towards cover point
nudged off the front foot towards point
full ball on off stump, Raina drives to long off
good length on off stump, Saha defends on the off side
length ball outside off, steered from the crease behind point

he's been caught right on the square leg boundary! It was the slower ball from Mahmood bowled on a length and Badrinath pulled it, pulled it straight to the substitute Dogra on the boundary. He took the catch and then looked back at his back foot. It was just inside the boundary
pushed from the crease to long on
superb timing, Raina uses the width outside off stump to square drive the offcutter past Marsh at backward point, third man had no chance on this outfield
that's wide outside off stump and Raina chases and edges it, the ball fell short of the keeper
bowled quick and in the blockhole, forced out and through midwicket
flatter ball on a straight line, Raina goes back and plays it back to the bowler
driven through the off side towards the fielder in the deep at cover
whipped off the front foot through midwicket
tossed up outside off stump, Badri uses the room and makes some of his own to loft the ball over extra cover for a one-bounce four
played off the front foot towards long on
another slower ball on a good length on off stump, Badri drives to cover
Raina goes back and works the ball towards midwicket
Raina also plays the ball back to Mahmood, it nearly carried to the bowler

caught and bowled! Mahmood rolled his fingers over the ball and it arrived much slower than Faf expected, he pushed at the ball too early and played it straight to Mahmood, who took the catch at stomach height
balls.dismissal: F du Plessis — caught and bowled

balls.text: now he charges and carves the ball inside out over point, not timed well
good length on middle stump after delivering from wide of the crease, Faf stays put and plays on the leg side
pulled towards Praveen Kumar once again

terrible fielding from the man at mid-on, Faf stepped out and made room before hitting down the ground, he did not time it all that well but Praveen Kumar still managed to dive over the ball and allow the boundary
Faf steps out again and thumps another length ball, this time the cover fielder is in the way
Faf steps out of his crease and dismisses a length ball from his presence with a commanding drive through extra cover
moves across his crease and paddles the ball behind square

edged and just wide of the diving keeper and to the boundary! Saini lunged to his right but couldn't reach the ball, Badri had come out of his crease to steer a length ball to third man, he didn't want to hit it that fine
nudged from the crease on the leg side
Faf skips out of his crease, gets to the pitch of the ball and hoists it with a lot of bottom hand over the deep midwicket boundary
Faf charges and swings, aiming to hit over cover, he got a thick outside edge over point and there are two fielders in pursuit. Bhatt gets to the ball first and dives but makes a mess of it
mis-timed back towards the bowler, he was looking to hit through cover
bowled into the right-hander from very wide of the crease, Faf doesn't make proper contact
that's bowled from very wide of the crease from round the wicket, played off the back foot behind point
full ball and Faf has lofted that dead straight with a clean swing and a full follow through, first six in the chase
Faf tries to hit through the off side but mis-times on the leg
Badri moves forward and across to work a length ball through square leg
length ball with a lot of width outside off, Badri stays back, moves towards the ball and square drives through point
Badri stays on the back foot and defends a good length ball towards cover
good length on middle and off, Faf whips the ball in front of square leg, he's staying in his crease because the keeper is up
a bit too short outside off, Badri goes back and cuts into the gap between short third man and backward point, no catching up with the ball on this outfield
Badri goes right back to a fullish ball and plays towards point
good length on off and middle, Badri moves forward and blocks
goes back to cut but the length is fuller outside off and Badri gets beaten, that bounced a bit more as well
tossed up on off stump, Badri plays the ball with soft hands, steering it to third man off the front foot, he opened the face late
played of the back foot to point
good length on of and middle stump, Faf gets behind the line and blocks
a full ball but a bit too wide outside off, Badri plays it towards third man from his crease
length ball outside off, Faf drives fluently through cover but a fielder gets a hand on it
that's a good call from the umpire, too many of them call it wide when the batsman moves towards the off side and then misses the ball down leg side. That was close to leg stump
once again Kumar bends the ball from a good length into Faf, who does not come forward as he hits to cover
Kumar swings the ball into the right-hander, Faf stays in his crease and drives to cover
